mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, U.AUTH_CD, A.AUTH_NM, U.EMAIL, U.TEL_NO, U.USE_YN FROM TB_USER U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AUTH A ON A.AUTH_CD = U.AUTH_CD WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.PASSWD = SHA2(#{passwd}, 256) AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, U.AUTH_CD, A.AUTH_NM, U.EMAIL, U.TEL_NO, U.USE_YN, U.LAST_LOGIN_DT FROM TB_USER U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AUTH A ON A.AUTH_CD = U.AUTH_CD WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT DEPT_ID, DEPT_NM, PARENT_DEPT_ID FROM TB_DEPT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DEPT_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER (USER_ID, USER_NM, PASSWD, DEPT_ID, AUTH_CD, EMAIL, TEL_NO, USE_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userNm}, SHA2(#{passwd}, 256), #{deptId}, #{authCd}, #{email}, #{telNo}, 'Y', NOW())
